shap_integration.description: Each state explanation is enriched with SHAP-EPS Alignment Score, computed as the weighted agreement between RF feature attribution weights and EPS component weights. HIGH alignment confirms EPS ranking is corroborated by the forecasting model. Critical misalignment flags states where EPS and RF diverge, indicating potential data quality issues or formula revision candidates.
